responsibility: Provides the main integer and memory scheduling description for Cortex-R4. It models the core’s dual-issue matrix with separate issue units and ALU/load-store reservations, defines instruction latencies and bypasses for scalar ALU, moves, shifts, multiply-accumulate families, division, loads/stores, branches, and calls, and is the base pipeline model that the companion cortex-r4f.md extends with VFP timing.
